subject.title: Discord thread reply after session done: silent message loss due to session-store CAS race, no retry unlike Telegram

question: Should this Discord-specific report wait on the shared self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, or should maintainers require Discord channel-level retry/requeue parity for `reply session initialization conflicted` errors before considering it fixed?
rationale: Current source proves both the shared conflict throw and the Discord non-retry path, but the open shared self-heal may remove the root cause without adding a hot-path Discord retry loop.

options.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the primary fix path, then validate Discord thread follow-ups before adding channel-specific retry logic.

options.title: Require Discord Retry Parity Now
options.body: Queue a separate Discord repair that classifies reply-session-init conflicts as retryable and preserves inbound replay with bounded backoff or visible failure.

options.title: Ask For Live Discord Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open while requesting a current-main Discord thread timing repro before choosing between shared-root and channel-level fixes.

recommendation.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the primary fix path, then validate Discord thread follow-ups before adding channel-specific retry logic.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has the strongest current-main history on the guarded reply-session initialization and session-accessor boundary where this owner-boundary choice sits.
